This application only recommends report consideration and never files a report.

evidence.value: CLEAR means no escalation under this limited illustrative scorecard, not that the customer is legitimate or all risks have been excluded. The demo lacks verified identity, customer purpose, a complete account history and live screening. Its risk score is not a probability or AI confidence level. Every case is synthetic and any real investigation needs authorized human review.
